dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: You mean blowing the goods dry with the strong wind from the Anemograna?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hmm... The wind will be strong enough for sure, but won't it blow the goods away?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Perhaps we can tie the boxes together and increase their total weight that way!

dialogues.speaker: Mats
dialogues.text: Huh. That's not a bad idea! I'll send someone to find Anemograna right now, and I'll send all the supplies over.

dialogues.speaker: Mats
dialogues.text: Thank you both very much. Please accept this as a token of my gratitude.
